themes.title: Far-right AfD party congress sparks mass protests in Germany
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) held its federal party congress in Erfurt amid massive protests, with tens of thousands demonstrating against the party's rise. The event saw re-election of leaders Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, while police deployed thousands of officers to manage clashes between protesters and delegates. This theme reflects a broader European trend of far-right gatherings facing public backlash and scrutiny.

themes.title: PP-Vox coalitions reshape Spain's regional governments
themes.blurb: Spain's conservative Partido Popular (PP) and far-right Vox have formed coalition governments in multiple regions, including Andalusia, Aragón, and Castilla y León. These alliances prioritize policies like 'national priority' for public services, anti-immigration measures, and tax cuts, sparking debates about the normalization of far-right politics in mainstream governance. The trend reflects a broader European pattern of center-right parties allying with far-right groups to secure power.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe continue to push anti-LGBTQ+ policies, from Spain's Vox opposing gender-inclusive language to Poland's PiS promoting traditional family values. These efforts reflect a coordinated transnational campaign to roll back LGBTQ+ rights, often framed as protecting 'traditional values' against progressive policies. The theme highlights the ongoing cultural battles shaping European politics.

themes.title: Javier Milei's regional alliances and anti-socialism bloc
themes.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei continues to build regional alliances with right-wing leaders like Peru's Keiko Fujimori and Colombia's Abelardo de la Espriella. His government's policies, including deregulation and austerity measures, align with a broader anti-socialist bloc in Latin America. This theme reflects Milei's efforts to position Argentina as a leader in the region's right-wing resurgence, mirroring transnational conservative movements in Europe and the U.S.

themes.title: Trump's America 250 celebrations spark political divisions
themes.blurb: President Donald Trump's leadership of America's 250th independence celebrations has highlighted deep political divisions in the U.S. His speeches at Mount Rushmore and other events have framed the anniversary as a battle between 'patriotic' conservatives and 'un-American' progressives. This theme reflects how right-wing leaders globally use national anniversaries to promote partisan narratives, from Hungary's Independence Day celebrations to Poland's commemoration of historical events.
